common_failure: Manifest reagent totals do not match protocol transfers or omit dilution buffer.
fix: Compute stock and diluent volumes explicitly and mirror those totals in manifest.reagents.
preferred_labware: 96 well plate plus reservoir or tube rack for stock and buffer
preferred_pipette: p20_single_gen2 for <=20 uL, p300_single_gen2 for larger diluent volumes

common_failure: Dilution direction, mix step, or carryover tip policy is unclear.
fix: Transfer from high to low concentration, mix after each dilution, and change tips between dilution points unless same-sample carryover is intentional.
preferred_labware: 96 well plate or strip wells plus reservoir for dilution buffer
preferred_pipette: p20_single_gen2 for small stocks, p300_single_gen2 for 50-200 uL steps

common_failure: Tip budget, plate map, or waste route is missing from manifest/runbook.
fix: Declare source/destination labware, tip racks, tips_required, tips_available, and waste/off-platform handoff notes.
preferred_labware: 96 well source plate, 96 well destination plate, NEST reservoir when needed
preferred_pipette: p300_single_gen2 for flexible maps; multichannel only for strict column operations

common_failure: Sample volume is not calculated from concentration, target mass, and final volume.
fix: Use sample_uL = target_mass_ng / concentration_ng_per_uL, then water_uL = final_uL - sample_uL and guard invalid concentrations.
preferred_labware: sample plate plus destination plate and water reservoir
preferred_pipette: p20_single_gen2 for low sample volumes, p300_single_gen2 for water backfill

common_failure: PCR/qPCR reagent totals omit master mix, primer, template, controls, or cold-chain notes.
fix: Group master mix/primer/template additions, include positive/negative/NTC controls, and keep manifest reagent totals aligned with protocol loops.
preferred_labware: 96 well PCR plate, cold block or tube rack for master mix and primers
preferred_pipette: p20_single_gen2 for PCR components; p300_single_gen2 only for bulk master mix pre-distribution
